hr_questions.question: Tell me about yourself.
What are your strengths?
What are your weaknesses?
Why should we hire you?
Why do you want this job?
Why did you choose computer science?
Tell me about your project.
Tell me about your internship.
Where do you see yourself in five years?
Tell me about a challenge you faced.
How do you handle pressure?
Tell me about a team experience.
What motivates you?
Why should we select you?
How do you handle criticism?
Describe a time you failed and what you learned.
How do you prioritize your work?
What is your greatest achievement so far?
How do you handle conflict with a coworker?
What do you know about our company?
Why do you want to leave your current role?
What are your salary expectations?
How do you keep yourself updated with new skills?
Describe your ideal work environment.
How do you handle tight deadlines?
What makes you different from other candidates?
Tell me about a time you took initiative.
How do you stay motivated during repetitive tasks?
What questions do you have for us?
How would your friends describe you?

technical_topics.prompt: Explain what Python is and describe one project where you used it.
Explain what SQL is used for and describe a query you have written.
Explain artificial intelligence in simple terms and give one real-world example.
Explain the difference between supervised and unsupervised learning.
Explain what natural language processing is and where it is used.
Walk through the architecture and purpose of a project you built.
Describe a technical task you performed during an internship.
Describe your approach to solving a complex technical problem.
List the key technologies you know and how you have applied them.
